==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I have to complete three trials while working alongside two spirits. One spirit resembles the grim reaper, but they have a silly personality. The other spirit resembles a witch with an afro, and is a skilled mechanic.

The trials involve dying multiple times. I have to leap on to giant, sparkling, rainbow colored, flowers. I have to travel through time itself and battle clouds of fear.

After completing all of the challenges, I acquire considerable wealth. But I am now the target of a futuristic, armored, female bounty hunter. Even the spirits that accompany me are afraid of her, and I don't know how to stop her.
